title: Clues from pollen

doesNotKnow: The modeled sample contains many grains of one illustrated form. Identified pollen can inform past vegetation, but transport, preservation and identification complicate the interpretation. The toy sample is not field data.

misconception: The first apparent interpretation is the only possible one.
objective: A sediment sample contains many grains matching a plant group. What can those grains contribute to a reconstruction?
